title: Petra and the Alibi
author: Oscar Voss
blurb: Oscar Thackeray, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
